content: Řumur n ujeǧid Artaḥcasta i Ɛizra
Awarni man aya, řami tuɣa d tagelda n Artaḥcasta, ajeǧid n Lfurs, aqa din Ɛizra, mmis n Saraya, mmis n Ɛazarya, mmis n Ḥilqiya,
mmis n Callum, mmis n Ṣaduq, mmis n Axiṭub,
mmis n Amarya, mmis n Ɛazarya, mmis n Marayut,
mmis n Zaraḥ-Yah, mmis n Ɛuzi, mmis n Buqqi,
mmis n Abicuɛa, mmis n Finḥas, mmis n Aliɛazar, mmis n Harun, arrays n ikehhanen.

Ɛizra wanita igeɛɛed-dd zi Babil. Netta tuɣa d ijj n umseřmad d amiɣis n Ccariɛa n Musa tenni tuɣa i d iwca SIDI, Arebbi n Israil, uca ajeǧid iwca as marra x tutra nnes minzi afus n SIDI, AREBBI nnes, tuɣa-t xas.
Deg useggʷas wiss sebɛa n ujeǧid Artaḥcasta geɛɛden akides ɣar Urcalim ijj n řqedd n ayt n Israil d ikehhanen d Ilawiyyen d imedyazen d iɛessasen n tewwura d imsexxaren n Zzawect Tameqqrant.
Deg uyur wiss xemsa n useggʷas wiss sebɛa n ujeǧid yiweḍ Ɛizra ɣar Urcalim.
Deg wass amezwaru n uyur amezwaru tuɣa-t d beddu n wuffuɣ zi Babil uca deg umezwaru n uyur wiss xemsa yiweḍ ɣar Urcalim, minzi tuɣa afus iṣebḥen n AREBBI xas,
maɣar Ɛizra igga deg wuř nnes ad yarzu di Ccariɛa n SIDI u ad tt igg u ad isseřmed tiweṣṣa d lfarayiḍ di Israil.
Ta d tiřemt n tebrat i iwca ujeǧid Artaḥcasta ak-d Ɛizra, akehhan d umseřmad n tira iqeddsen, wenni d amseřmad deg wawařen n řumurat n SIDI d tweṣṣa nnes i Israil:
“Artaḥcasta, ajeǧid n ijeǧiden, i Ɛizra, akehhan d umseřmad n Ccariɛa n Arebbi n ijenwan, řehna imun! ... uca ɛad.”
“Ittwassuffeɣ-dd zzayi řumur ḥima kuř ijj di tgeldit inu zi řgens n Israil u zeg ikehhanen d Ilawiyyen, wenni s yixef nnes ixs ad yuyur ɣar Urcalim, ad kidek yuyur.
Aqa cek tᵉttwassekked s ufus n ujeǧid d sebɛa n imcawaren nnes ḥima ad tbeqqced di mammec teǧa řḥař di Yahuda u di Urcalim, ɛlaḥsab Ccariɛa n Arebbi tenni iǧan deg ifassen nnec.
Tᵉttwasekked ɛawed ḥima ad din tawyed nnuqart d wureɣ nni tuɣa iwca ujeǧid d imcawaren nnes s řxaḍar i Arebbi n Israil, wenni ɣar teǧa Tzeddiɣt di Urcalim,
u ɛawed marra nnuqart d wureɣ i ɣa tafed di marra lɛamala n Babil, ak-d tewhibin n uṭewweɛ n řgens d ikehhanen, zeg inni i ɣa iwcen s uṭewweɛ i Taddart n Arebbi nsen tenni iǧan di Urcalim,

ḥima xenni ad tesɣed s nnuqart-a s cḍaret ifunasen, icarriyyen, izmaren ak-d tewhibin nnes n řɣiǧet d tewhibin n useyyeb ḥima ad tent tqeddmed x uɛalṭar n Taddart n Arebbi nnec, tenni iǧan di Urcalim.
S min ɣa iqqimen n nnuqart d wureɣ ggem zzayes min tᵉttwařid cek d aytmac mliḥ, ɛlaḥsab řxaḍar n Arebbi nwem.
Uca řeqcuɛ i d ac immewcen i tsexxart di Taddart n Arebbi, seɛdu ten ɣar din zzat Arebbi n Urcalim.
Min ɣa ixeṣṣen ɛad ktar i Taddart n Arebbi nnec, min ɣa yiři xak ad t txeǧṣed, ewc i-t zeg wexxam n txubay n ujeǧid.

Necc, ajeǧid Artaḥcasta, ssuffeɣ-dd řumur i marra imeḥḍayen x txubay di temmurt x ujemmaḍ n iɣzar n Lfuraṭ, maḥend ad immewc s cḍaret marra min zzaywem ɣa ittar ukehhan Ɛizra, amseřmad n Ccariɛa n Arebbi n ijenwan,
ař mya talint n nnuqart, ař mya ikuruten n irden, ař mya ibatuten n binu u ař mya ibatuten n zzect, uca i tmeǧaḥt war din bu tewṣeyyet.
Marra min iǧan zi řumur n Arebbi n ijenwan, ad ittwagg s cḍaret i Taddart n Arebbi n ijenwan, minzi mayemmi i dd ɣa yas weɣḍab x tgeldit n ujeǧid d iḥenjiren nnes?

Zi jjihet n marra ikehhanen d Ilawiyyen, d imeɣnujen d iɛessasen n tewwura d imsexxaren n Zzawect Tameqqrant d imsexxaren n Taddart n Arebbi wanita, aqa ad kenniw nxebbar, war izemmar ad xasen ittwagg řeɛcur, řa d ljizya uřa d ḍḍariba n webrid.

Maca cek, Ɛizra, s tiɣit i d ac immewcen zi Arebbi nnec, řeqqem imḍebbaren d řquḍat nni i ɣa iḥekmen x marra řgens nni iǧan di temmurt x ujemmaḍ n iɣzar n Lfuraṭ, i marra inni issnen izerfan n Arebbi. Uca i yinni war ten issinen, ittxeṣṣa ad ten dd-tessargbed.
Kuř ijjen wenni war iḍfaren Ccariɛa n Arebbi nwem d uzerf n ujeǧid, ittxeṣṣa ad ittwaḥkem s cḍaret, ma s řmewt niɣ s lmenfa niɣ s multa n wagřa niɣ s řeḥbes.”
Asemɣar i SIDI, Arebbi n řejdud nneɣ, wenni iggin aya ammu deg wuř n ujeǧid ḥima ad yarni acenneɛ di Taddart n SIDI nni iǧan di Urcalim.

Aqa Netta isscen ayi tamexsiwt nnes icewwaren zzat i wudem n ujeǧid d imcawaren nnes d marra řḥukkam ijehden n ujeǧid! Uca umi xafi tuɣa afus n SIDI, AREBBI inu, ggiɣ uř u ssmuneɣ izeǧifen n Israil ḥima ad kidi geɛɛden.
